text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The winner of this year's "Oka Sho" is...
Vivlos, it is Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She has avenged her older sister Verxina...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis / Big brother...
Big sis / Big brother...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos dashed straight into the stands...
and threw her arms around Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I did it!
I won~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that heartwarming sight,
spontaneous applause erupted from throughout the venue—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though Vivlos was completely drained right after the race, after a little time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I feel even better than before the race!
I could totally run another one!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh.
I mean, I'm feeling super great, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"All my tiredness is totally gone now!
I could even train right now, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to feel nothing right now due to the excitement of the race...
but letting herself get swept up in it is dangerous.
choice_data_list: Let's rest a bit more before we head out.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Trainy, are you being a bit of a worrywart?
choice_data_list: You're what matters most to me.
You are what's most important to me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: Make sure to get plenty of rest before the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's what you meant... of course...
Phew, you scared me."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of your precious, preeeecious me,
I'm gonna get plenty of rest today, Trainie♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the second crown of the Triple Tiara...
The Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Phone Sound
text_block_list.text: "This year's Oka Sho ended in a dramatic victory for Vivlos, claiming the crown her elder sister Verxina could never grasp—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ever since you were a child,
you've been able to do anything.
